name: Laufgitter
install:
set -eu
REPO="$PWD"
python3 -m py_compile "$REPO/laufgitter.py" "$REPO/engines/mock_worker.py"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/laufgitter" "$HOME/.laufgitter"
cat > "$HOME/.config/laufgitter/config.toml" <<EOF
# Laufgitter config for the Cloud Agent development environment (generated by install).
# Enables the stdlib mock engine so verified swarms run end to end with no API key.
state_dir = "~/.laufgitter"
dashboard_port_base = 8787
allow_full_access = false

[update]
auto = false

[eval]
backend = "jsonl"
jsonl_path = "~/.laufgitter/runs.jsonl"

[engines.codex]
bin = "codex"
args_template = ["exec", "--skip-git-repo-check", "{access_args}", "{model_args}", "{engine_args}", "-C", "{taskdir}", "{spec}"]
sandbox_args = ["--sandbox", "workspace-write"]
full_access_args = ["--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox"]

[engines.mock]
bin = "python3"
args_template = ["$REPO/engines/mock_worker.py", "{spec}"]
sandbox_args = []
full_access_args = []

[artifact]
enabled = true
out = "~/.laufgitter/artifacts/{run_id}.html"
report_out = "~/.laufgitter/artifacts/{run_id}-report.html"
index_out = "~/.laufgitter/artifacts/index.html"
EOF
git config --global commit.gpgsign false || true
echo '[install] complete'

terminals.name: zentrale
terminals.description: Zentrale live dashboard for Laufgitter swarm runs (http://127.0.0.1:8700).
